regions.label: Motion Distinction
regions.description: Gradient orientation statistics distinguish GENERAL and PARALLEL motion.

regions.label: Patch Extraction
regions.description: Polarity-based clustering extracts candidate patch regions for local corner initialization.

regions.label: Corner Initialization - GENERAL
regions.description: Seed pixels propagate along edges. Two fitted lines initialize the corner at their intersection.

regions.label: Corner Initialization - PARALLEL
regions.description: Motion direction and polarity transitions recover the suppressed edge, which intersects the visible edge to initialize the corner.

regions.label: Corner Refinement
regions.description: Low event density guides sub-pixel refinement within geometric edge constraints.

regions.label: Optimization
regions.description: Refined corners from multiple event windows are used to estimate camera parameters by minimizing reprojection error.
